messages:
Rae: Noticed someone left a sticky note on my monitor that says 'fine-tune me later' with a tiny caricature of a toaster. Is this how our models are asking for mentorship now? :toaster:
build-bot: [ci] lint -> passed, deploy -> queued, model_mentorship_ticket_#421 created
Diego: haha paste the note pls
Rae: 'Dear Team, I have a small dataset of breakfast preferences and would like better generative toast suggestions. Attached: 4 emoji samples.'
Zoe: is this a request for supervised learning or just passive-aggressive snack commentary? :laughing:
Mina: we should open a guide: 'How to mentor your office appliances (and interns)'
Rae: draft title: 'Pair programming with your toaster: prompts, patience, and pastries'
Diego: table of contents idea:
```
1. Introductions: say hello to your toaster
2. Prompt hygiene: avoid ambiguous crumbs
3. Safety: don't teach it to set fire to croissants
4. Evaluation: taste tests at snack hour
```
Zoe: Phil-bot already chimed in: "I prefer bagels, but will accept co-training on sourdough." :bagel:
phil-bot: Hello humans. Friendly reminder: always check for crumbs before finetuning. --Phil (plant, not the person)
Mina: poll: If an appliance self-documents a 'skills' section, do we credit it on the team page?
Mina: :thumbsup: yes, honorary title
Mina: :thumbsdown: no, only humans get headshots
Diego: I'd make it an intern role: 'Junior Generative Snack Assistant'
Rae: action: adding a label 'appliance-collab' to the board and ordering tiny name badges.
